mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months signals a shift to accommodative monetary policy, lowering discount rates and increasing present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a sudden tightening cycle, raising discount rates and compressing expected equity valuations, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 1% for 3 consecutive months indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below -0.5% for 2 consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, which raises uncertainty and compresses earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) above 110.5 signals robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings momentum and lowers risk premia, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 2% for 3 consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts earnings expectations and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below -1% for 2 consecutive months signals a cooling demand environment, which raises uncertainty and compresses earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in cooling periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% for 3 consecutive months signals a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
